parsed.note_claim: On 2 January 2024 a Japan Airlines A350 collided with a Japan Coast Guard DHC-8 at Haneda; everyone on the JAL flight survived, and the DHC-8 had five fatalities and one survivor.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Five of the six crew on board the Dash 8 died in the collision, leaving only the captain alive. Everyone on board the A350 survived.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms the date, the collision at Haneda, all A350 occupants surviving, and 5 of 6 Coast Guard crew dying with one survivor; the note's flight-number labels (774/516) differ, but the page uses 516 consistently with the note's 'JAL 516'.
